summary: One choice among a few visible, mutually exclusive options. Arrow keys move the selection; the group has a legend and optional per-option descriptions.
whenToUse: Two to about six exclusive options that benefit from being compared side by side.
Options that need a description to choose well.
horizontal only for two or three short options, like Light, Dark, System.
whenNotToUse: More than about six options, or options users know by name: use Select.
A single on or off: use Switch or Checkbox.
Switching views of content: use Tabs.

dos.title: Preselect the safest or most common option
dos.text: A default saves a decision; pick the one most teams want.

donts.title: A single radio button
donts.text: One radio cannot be unselected. Use a Checkbox.

accessibility: Base UI RadioGroup: role radiogroup named by the legend; one tab stop, arrow keys move and select.
Each radio is labelled by its text (aria-labelledby) and described by its description.
The group error is linked with aria-describedby and sets aria-invalid; it shows an icon and text.
Selected uses the ink fill with a light dot; the unselected edge is color.border.strong (3:1).
contentGuidelines: Legend asks the question; options answer it in parallel form.
Keep option labels to a few words; move detail to the description.
Errors say what to do: "Pick a merge strategy before you publish."
